title: TIB: Sample-wise Tempered Information Bottleneck for Multimodal Attribution beyond Alignment Assumption
abstract: arXiv:2611.12997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal (e.g. vision-language, in this work) attribution aims to interpret the models without access to ground-truth explanatory supervision. Existing multimodal attribution methods typically rely on paired modalities as proxy supervision, implicitly assuming that image-text pairs are semantically aligned. Information bottleneck (IB)-based attribution methods follow this general paradigm and instantiate it through a global sufficiency-compression objective. In realistic multimodal datasets, however, this assumption is frequently violated due to partial semantic misalignment and unreliable cross-modal correspondences. Through theoretical analysis, we show that, under such misalignment, information-bottleneck-based attribution objectives exhibit a structural limitation: by assuming equal reliability across all proxy supervision signals, they induce posterior over-contraction and forced explanations. translated_title: TIB：超越对齐假设的样本级温和信息瓶颈多模态归因方法
translated_abstract: 多模态（例如本文中的视觉-语言）归因旨在在无法获得真实解释性监督的情况下对模型进行解释。现有多模态归因方法通常依赖配对的模态作为代理监督，隐式地假设图像-文本对在语义上是对齐的。基于信息瓶颈（IB）的归因方法遵循这一通用范式，并通过全局充分性-压缩目标将其具体化。然而，在现实的多模态数据集中，由于部分语义错位和不可靠的跨模态对应关系，这一假设经常被违反。通过理论分析，我们证明在这种错位情况下，基于信息瓶颈的归因目标存在结构性局限：由于假设所有代理监督信号具有同等的可靠性，它们会导致后验过度收缩和强制解释。为解决这一问题，我们提出了T……
tldr: 该论文提出TIB方法，通过样本级温和信息瓶颈突破现有多模态归因方法对模态对齐假设的依赖，解决了在语义错位情况下代理监督信号可靠性不均导致的后验过度收缩与强制解释问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TIB, a sample-wise tempered information bottleneck method that moves beyond the alignment assumption in multimodal attribution, addressing posterior over-contraction and forced explanations caused by unequal reliability of proxy supervision under semantic misalignment.
